title: Atlas Time
description: This Plugin allows you to execute commands via the server based on the Player's Play Time on the server. You can do commands such as "give {playerName} diamond 1" or use it to rank people up when they have reached a specified playtime.
body:
# AtlasTime

AtlasTime allows you to execute commands automatically based on a player's playtime. You can reward players, rank them up, or trigger any server command once they reach specific time milestones.

This works for both total playtime and daily playtime, making it ideal for progression systems and retention rewards.

---

## Features

- Execute commands based on player playtime  
- Supports total playtime and daily playtime tracking  
- Fully customizable time milestones  
- Run any server command such as rewards or rank upgrades  
- Configurable messages, sounds, and formatting  
- Automatic time checking system  
- Supports unlimited time frames  

---

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|--------|------------|------------|
| `/atime help` | Show all commands | `atlastime.help` |
| `/atime reload` | Reload config files | `atlastime.reloadconfig` |
| `/atime time` | View total and daily playtime | `atlastime.time` |
| `/atime resetdaily` | Reset daily playtime for all players | `atlastime.resetdaily` |
| `/atime forcecheck` | Force a playtime check for all players | `atlastime.forcecheck` |

---

## How It Works

- The plugin tracks each player's total and daily playtime  
- At set intervals, it checks if players have reached configured time milestones  
- When a milestone is reached, configured commands are executed automatically  
- Messages and sounds can also be triggered
